description: DeltaDTM v1.1 coastal DTM (Copernicus GLO-30 corrected with ICESat-2 and GEDI, non-terrain removed and interpolated), float32 metres above EGM2008, one window per KHG work folder in _khg (the 11 resolved main KHG, reserves Sugihan - Lumpur and Tebing Tinggi, and Kampar - Gaung), each KHG plus 2 km.
source: Pronk et al. 2024 (doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03091-9), data doi:10.4121/21997565 (4TU, CC BY 4.0). Fetched through Earth Engine asset projects/sat-io/open-datasets/DELTARES/deltadtm_v1-1 (GEE community catalog) with repeat_common.gee, project ee-danylaksono, 2026-10-25 (Mendahara, Sugihan - Lumpur) and 2026-10-26 (the rest).
remarks: On the native 1 arcsec grid (same lattice as GLO-30), not resampled. Masked pixels written as -9999 (unmask). Inputs (Pronk et al. 2024, read through Europe PMC PMC10917791): CopernicusDEM from TanDEM-X 2012-2015, ICESat-2 ATL08 v6 2018-10-14 to 2023-06-22 (bias correction over open land cover), GEDI L2A v2 2019-04-18 to 2023-03-16 (coarse helper DTM for the filter only); non-terrain cells are classified with morphological filters and removed, then voids interpolated; no canopy-height threshold. The product is defined for land below 10 m +MSL. The GEE copy holds values up to 30 m and saturates at exactly 30.00: an elevation cap, not a canopy cap (Saleh-Sugihan: under cells at 30.00 the LiDAR median is 37.4 m). Values above 10 m are outside the product's scope (Saleh-Sugihan 10-30 m cells: DeltaDTM - LiDAR median -1.30 m; Mendahara +3.47 m). 4TU was unreachable from this machine (TCP connect fails).

description: Peat extent for Indonesia from the GFW global peatland extent, a composite: for Indonesia the union of Miettinen et al. 2016 and Gumbricht et al. 2017, rasterised or resampled to 30 m; taken at zoom 11 (about 76 m) for the tiles that touch a KHG: 1 = peat, 0 = no peat, 255 = tile not fetched

year: GFW layer version v20230315 (dates of the source maps not recorded here)
remarks: Only tiles touching a KHG are filled (everything else is 255). A mapped extent, not a survey. The union means the peat area can exceed either source alone; the Miettinen paper covers Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo, so Papua rests on Gumbricht et al. 2017 (modelled). Partially transparent edge cells count as peat (alpha > 0): fully opaque cells only would give about 6% less (24 tiles sampled). About 20-30 points above the 1 km Global Peatland Map in median KHG peat share, per island: see the report. Full-resolution download needs a free GFW API key. Used to count fire on peat and for peat area per KHG. 2026-10-23: 9 tiles added for KHG.63.01-03-71-72.01 (fetch_peat_extent --extra klhk_khg_feg_50k.gpkg:khg); grid unchanged.
